1. Mr. Vinod Tiwari, learned counsel for the 
petitioner and Mr. Tilak Sharma, learned counsel

counsel for the respondents.

this writ petition, the petitioner already submitted 
a representation to the respondents.

submits that the representation of the petitioner 
shall be decided preferably within a period of ten
